description: imboyapp auto-test stable state & evidence schema (plan Step 6, run hardening-20260918T151153Z). Enums here are the declaration; scripts/auto_test_lib/state.py and evidence.py enforce them and tests keep both in sync.

fields.scope_verdict: enum layers.scope_verdict or empty until rolled up

fields.test_status: enum layers.test_status_with_unknown; UNKNOWN is the plan-time placeholder only

evidence.head: 40-char lowercase hex git sha
evidence.backend_head_not_applicable_rule: legal only when the target requirements contain no backend.*, credentials.* or fixture.* entry (API/WS/persistence/cross-client oracles)

evidence_levels.A: real client device -> isolated backend -> peer/persistence black-box evidence
evidence_levels.B: current-HEAD replayable app/backend integration or contract test
evidence_levels.D: docs/TODO/test-name/history/static inference; can never carry PASS alone

evidence.spec_may_only: raise the floor, never lower it

cache.exact_hit: all CacheKey fields equal (app/backend head, target/runner/config/dependency hashes, environment & device fingerprints, level, extra_binding)

conditions: evidence head is an ancestor of the final head (git merge-base --is-ancestor)

lease.acquire: atomic mkdir + tmp file fsync + atomic rename to owner.json
lease.stale: heartbeat gap > 120s is mark-only, never preempted
